params.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic photo, square frame. A bright modern open-plan office flooded with low golden-hour sunlight streaming through tall windows, dramatic sun rays and dust in the air. Sleek black-and-gold humanoid robots confidently work at every desk with glowing screens full of charts. In the sharp foreground an empty office chair is rolled aside next to a cardboard box with a dismissed worker's belongings (a mug, a plant, a framed photo). Vivid saturated colors, rich warm golden and amber light with hot orange highlights, high contrast, crisp detail, cinematic, energetic. The upper 42% of the frame is a deeper warm gradient (amber to near-black) so a white headline reads clearly. No text, no letters, no logos, no green.
